environment.description: Same service on ECS Fargate with task role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/OrderServiceRoleScoped. The IAM policy uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition with ForAllValues:StringEquals set to ${aws:PrincipalTag/TenantId}, and additionally the policy includes a Deny statement with StringNotLike on dynamodb:FilterExpression condition key restricting filter expressions to patterns matching only 'attribute_exists(item_id) AND status = *' or 'attribute_exists(item_id) AND created_after = *'. The DynamoDB VPC endpoint has a resource policy that further enforces dynamodb:LeadingKeys. The ECS task has a PrincipalTag 'TenantId' propagated from the OIDC identity provider federation. Note: the Deny with dynamodb:FilterExpression is evaluated BEFORE any Allow per IAM policy evaluation logic.

config.principal_tag_source: OIDC federation with immutable TenantId claim
